requests.reply: {"translations": ["Start with Memotto", "Memotto is a note app that can combine text, tables, and images into one.", "In this guide, we will explain with examples from Yamanishi in PR and Takanashi in Sales."]}

{"translations": ["A short note attached to a page is called a 'Quick Note'.", "Tsukimisato-san leaves meeting decisions in a Quick Note.", "Tsukimisato-san puts sticky notes on important parts as markers."]}
{"translations": ["One thing is, you can add up to ten items per page."]}
{"translations": ["For use by the team", "Takanashi's sales team first created a workspace.", "The place where everyone can see inside the workspace is called 'Hiroba' (Commons)."]}
{"translations": ["Anyone can post a memo in the plaza.", "Kotori-san shares the business schedule in the plaza every morning.", "You can invite members to the workspace via email."]}
{"translations": ["Invited people will receive a confirmation email."]}

{"translations": ["Notes are saved automatically and synced to all devices.","You can edit offline, and it will sync as soon as you connect,","You can revert to a previous state from the page history."]}
{"translations": ["Tsukimisato-san recovered the text she accidentally deleted."]}
